text:
yara: quick heads-up from the onboarding run — intermittent leak of email in logs when auth retry happens. looks like two different req ids for the same logical flow. repro below.

kevin: oof. paste the lines + how you wired telemetry.

yara: sanitized snippet:
```
INFO 2026-05-04T08:21:10Z req=alpha42 user=zoe@example.com step=auth.start
INFO 2026-05-04T08:21:11Z req=alpha42 step=auth.retry attempt=1
INFO 2026-05-04T08:21:12Z req=omega99 user=zoe@example.com step=auth.done
```
first two are redacted as expected, last one leaked the email and has a different req id. SDK init in sample app:
```
Telemetry.init({ hooks: [onAttachHook, samplingHook, redactHook] })
```
app uses express + retry middleware that re-dispatches the handler. suspect the second emission bypasses redact since hook was attach-time only.

lee: does this repro only on Node? any python/mobile hits?

yara: tested node express sampleapp with sdk 0.12.3-canary. mobile/native shims were clean in a small smoke run. python not repro'd yet.

kevin: likely cause = hook timing + retry re-emit. If redact runs at attach and the retry creates a fresh record later with a new trace id, redact never sees it. two options: wire redact to final emit pipeline or make redact idempotent and re-run on emit.

lee: a small local hack I used before: mark records once redacted so re-emits skip the expensive ops. e.g.:
```js
logger.on('record', rec => { if (!rec.__redacted) { redact(rec); rec.__redacted = true } });
```
fixed the leak in my local repro.

ops-bot: created ticket DE-5412: "node sdk: retry replay emits new req id and misses PII redaction" -> https://jira/redwood/DE-5412 :white_check_mark:

kevin: plan suggestion: (1) add integration test simulating express retry re-dispatch asserting stable req_id + no PII; (2) change node SDK default to run redact on emit stage, keep attach-mode behind a compat flag; (3) add cheap marker to avoid double-redact; (4) ship a canary and monitor PII/PII-leak alerting.

yara: i can add the repro and a tiny demo app for the test. qa, can you add a fuzz run to try to hit this more often?

qa: yep, will add a small harness that replays request-flows with randomized retries and assert no raw emails in logs.

lee: perf note: we should microbench redact-on-emit vs attach. attach might be lighter when no retries happen, but emit is safer for odd middleware. include benchmark in PR.

kevin: agreed. i'll own the PR and add migration notes in SDK changelog and upgrade guide. thanks y'all.
